name: Laguna Parón shore walk
region: Huascarán National Park, Cordillera Blanca, above Caraz
why: Along the turquoise water of the Cordillera Blanca's largest lake, 4,200 m up, towards the perfect snow pyramid of Pirámide de Garcilaso and the walls of Artesonraju.
book: Inside Huascarán National Park, but the lake is run by the Cruz de Mayo community: in 2019 it charged S/5 and the park ticket did not apply. From Caraz about 2 h by taxi or tour (no colectivo to the lake); day tours from Huaraz.
water: None to buy on the path: carry 1.5 litres.
dangers: 4,200 m: walk slowly if you came up from Huaraz or Caraz the same day.
A rough, wet stretch on the north shore in the rainy season.
Cold wind off the glaciers in the afternoon.
turnaround: Turn round at half the time your driver waits: the east end of the lake is about 1.5 hours away on foot.

points.name: Parón dam and refuge
points.note: Where the road ends at 4,185 m, by the refuge and the boats: the classic view up the lake to the Pirámide.

points.name: Head of Laguna Parón, under the Pirámide de Garcilaso
points.note: The east end of the lake: the Pirámide's ice face straight ahead, Artesonraju and its glacier to the left. Back the same way.
